name: defective_clearance_item_support_escalation
use_case: Support case escalation and service error recovery
branch: Delivered final-sale clearance item arrives defective with a hole, requiring store credit escalation per policy exceptions
tests: the agent checks product returnability/order, explains final sale exclusion, and opens a support case for store credit exception
instruction:
You purchased a Clearance Wool Scarf (SKU FS05) in order O422, but upon delivery you discovered it has a hole in the fabric. You know clearance is final sale, but because it arrived defective, you want an exception for store credit.

Your details:
Name: Marcus Vance
Email: marcus.vance@example.com
Postal code: 75001
Order ID: O422
SKU: FS05

persona.name: Marcus Vance
persona.initial_message: Hi, my clearance scarf (order O422, SKU FS05) arrived with a hole in it. Since it arrived damaged, I need a case opened for store credit.

arguments.subject: Defective clearance item
arguments.details: Clearance Wool Scarf FS05 arrived with a hole; requesting store credit exception
